text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Postal Services Commission (PostCom)", "gist": "PostCom is a Swiss postal market supervisory body"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "PostCom is a technically independent body responsible for supervising the Swiss postal market.", "gist": "PostCom is an independent Swiss postal market regulator"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "It sees to it that basic postal services are efficient, of good quality and affordable to all.", "gist": "PostCom ensures postal services are efficient, high quality, and affordable"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Rail Transport Commission (RailCom)", "gist": "RailCom is a Swiss rail transport commission"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The Rail Transport Commission (RailCom) is responsible for handling disputes regarding access to the railway network and the calculation of fees for the use of infrastructure.", "gist": "RailCom handles railway access disputes and fee calculations"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "In its supervisory capacity, RailCom monitors compliance with the principles of non-discrimination and transparency.", "gist": "RailCom supervises railway access to ensure non-discrimination and transparency"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "RailCom was established as part of the 1999 railways reform, which mainly sought to introduce free access to the railway network.", "gist": "RailCom was created during the 1999 railway reform to promote open network access"}]}
